const yesterday = DateTime.now().setZone('America/Bogota').minus({ days: 1 }).toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd');
const yesterdayUtc = DateTime.now().setZone('America/Bogota').minus({ days: 1 }).startOf('day').toISO();

const testCases = [
  {
    order: 1,
    id: "TC_WSP_001",
    name: "Celebration — 100% sesiones completadas",
    priority: "CRITICAL",
    category: "WEEKLY_SCHEDULING_PROMPT",
    phone: '570000000071',
    userId: 'e2e00071-0000-0000-0000-000000000061',
    expectedScenario: "CELEBRATION",
    cleanup: [
      "DELETE FROM user_weekly_schedule WHERE user_id = 'e2e00071-0000-0000-0000-000000000061'",
      "DELETE FROM users_plans WHERE user_id = 'e2e00071-0000-0000-0000-000000000061'",
      "DELETE FROM users_gym_profile WHERE whatsapp_id = 570000000071",
      "DELETE FROM users WHERE user_id = 'e2e00071-0000-0000-0000-000000000061'",
      "INSERT INTO users (user_id, full_name, cel_number, full_phone_number, email, timezone, created_at, country_indicative) VALUES ('e2e00071-0000-0000-0000-000000000061', 'Test_WSP_Celebration', 570000000071, '570000000071', 'wsp_celeb@test.com', 'America/Bogota', NOW(), 57)",
      "INSERT INTO users_plans (plan_id, user_id, template_id, start_date, goal, level, status, mesocycle_number, week_schedule) VALUES ('e2e00071-0a01-0000-0000-000000000061', 'e2e00071-0000-0000-0000-000000000061', 'tpl_fb_3_hyp_int', NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days', 'Ganar masa muscular', 'Intermedio', 'active', 1, 'fb_3')",
      "INSERT INTO user_weekly_schedule (day_routine_id, user_id, week, week_day, session_name, planned_day, planned_day_utc, \"Completed\") VALUES ('e2e00071-5c01-0000-0000-000000000061', 'e2e00071-0000-0000-0000-000000000061', 1, 'Lunes', 'Full Body A', '" + yesterday + "', '" + yesterdayUtc + "', true)",
      "INSERT INTO user_weekly_schedule (day_routine_id, user_id, week, week_day, session_name, planned_day, planned_day_utc, \"Completed\") VALUES ('e2e00071-5c02-0000-0000-000000000061', 'e2e00071-0000-0000-0000-000000000061', 1, 'Miercoles', 'Full Body B', '" + yesterday + "', '" + yesterdayUtc + "', true)",
      "INSERT INTO user_weekly_schedule (day_routine_id, user_id, week, week_day, session_name, planned_day, planned_day_utc, \"Completed\") VALUES ('e2e00071-5c03-0000-0000-000000000061', 'e2e00071-0000-0000-0000-000000000061', 1, 'Viernes', 'Full Body C', '" + yesterday + "', '" + yesterdayUtc + "', true)"
    ],
    validations: [
      {
        id: "V-WSP-101",
        description: "User appears in detection query",
        sql: "WITH current_week_stats AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.full_phone_number, u.full_name, uws.week::int AS current_week, ws.days_per_week::int AS total_sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE uws.\"Completed\" = true)::int AS completed_count, MAX(uws.planned_day) AS last_planned_day FROM users u JOIN users_plans up ON u.user_id = up.user_id AND up.status = 'active' JOIN week_schedules ws ON up.week_schedule = ws.schedule_type JOIN user_weekly_schedule uws ON u.user_id = uws.user_id WHERE uws.week BETWEEN 1 AND 3 GROUP BY u.user_id, u.full_phone_number, u.full_name, uws.week, ws.days_per_week) SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM current_week_stats cws WHERE cws.user_id = 'e2e00071-0000-0000-0000-000000000061' AND cws.last_planned_day < TO_CHAR(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND cws.last_planned_day >= TO_CHAR((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota') - INTERVAL '3 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_weekly_schedule uws2 WHERE uws2.user_id = cws.user_id AND uws2.week = cws.current_week + 1)",
        expected: 1,
        operator: "="
      },
      {
        id: "V-WSP-102",
        description: "completed_count equals total_sessions (CELEBRATION scenario)",
        sql: "WITH current_week_stats AS (SELECT u.user_id, uws.week::int AS current_week, ws.days_per_week::int AS total_sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE uws.\"Completed\" = true)::int AS completed_count, MAX(uws.planned_day) AS last_planned_day FROM users u JOIN users_plans up ON u.user_id = up.user_id AND up.status = 'active' JOIN week_schedules ws ON up.week_schedule = ws.schedule_type JOIN user_weekly_schedule uws ON u.user_id = uws.user_id WHERE uws.week BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND u.user_id = 'e2e00071-0000-0000-0000-000000000061' GROUP BY u.user_id, uws.week, ws.days_per_week) SELECT CASE WHEN completed_count = total_sessions THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as cnt FROM current_week_stats",
        expected: 1,
        operator: "="
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    order: 2,
    id: "TC_WSP_002",
    name: "Growth — sesiones parcialmente completadas",
    priority: "CRITICAL",
    category: "WEEKLY_SCHEDULING_PROMPT",

      "DELETE FROM users_gym_profile WHERE whatsapp_id = 570000000072",
      "DELETE FROM users WHERE user_id = 'e2e00072-0000-0000-0000-000000000062'",
      "INSERT INTO users (user_id, full_name, cel_number, full_phone_number, email, timezone, created_at, country_indicative) VALUES ('e2e00072-0000-0000-0000-000000000062', 'Test_WSP_Growth', 570000000072, '570000000072', 'wsp_growth@test.com', 'America/Bogota', NOW(), 57)",
      "INSERT INTO users_plans (plan_id, user_id, template_id, start_date, goal, level, status, mesocycle_number, week_schedule) VALUES ('e2e00072-0a01-0000-0000-000000000062', 'e2e00072-0000-0000-0000-000000000062', 'tpl_fb_3_hyp_int', NOW() - INTERVAL '21 days', 'Ganar masa muscular', 'Intermedio', 'active', 1, 'fb_3')",
      "INSERT INTO user_weekly_schedule (day_routine_id, user_id, week, week_day, session_name, planned_day, planned_day_utc, \"Completed\") VALUES ('e2e00072-5c01-0000-0000-000000000062', 'e2e00072-0000-0000-0000-000000000062', 2, 'Lunes', 'Full Body A', '" + yesterday + "', '" + yesterdayUtc + "', true)",
      "INSERT INTO user_weekly_schedule (day_routine_id, user_id, week, week_day, session_name, planned_day, planned_day_utc, \"Completed\") VALUES ('e2e00072-5c02-0000-0000-000000000062', 'e2e00072-0000-0000-0000-000000000062', 2, 'Miercoles', 'Full Body B', '" + yesterday + "', '" + yesterdayUtc + "', false)",
      "INSERT INTO user_weekly_schedule (day_routine_id, user_id, week, week_day, session_name, planned_day, planned_day_utc, \"Completed\") VALUES ('e2e00072-5c03-0000-0000-000000000062', 'e2e00072-0000-0000-0000-000000000062', 2, 'Viernes', 'Full Body C', '" + yesterday + "', '" + yesterdayUtc + "', false)"

      {

        expected: 1,
        operator: "="
      },
      {
        id: "V-WSP-202",
        description: "completed_count > 0 AND < total_sessions (GROWTH scenario)",
        sql: "WITH current_week_stats AS (SELECT u.user_id, uws.week::int AS current_week, ws.days_per_week::int AS total_sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE uws.\"Completed\" = true)::int AS completed_count, MAX(uws.planned_day) AS last_planned_day FROM users u JOIN users_plans up ON u.user_id = up.user_id AND up.status = 'active' JOIN week_schedules ws ON up.week_schedule = ws.schedule_type JOIN user_weekly_schedule uws ON u.user_id = uws.user_id WHERE uws.week BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND u.user_id = 'e2e00072-0000-0000-0000-000000000062' GROUP BY u.user_id, uws.week, ws.days_per_week) SELECT CASE WHEN completed_count > 0 AND completed_count < total_sessions THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as cnt FROM current_week_stats",
        expected: 1,
        operator: "="
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    order: 3,
    id: "TC_WSP_003",
    name: "Re-engagement — 0 sesiones completadas",
    priority: "CRITICAL",
    category: "WEEKLY_SCHEDULING_PROMPT",
    phone: '570000000073',
    userId: 'e2e00073-0000-0000-0000-000000000063',
    expectedScenario: "RE_ENGAGEMENT",
    cleanup: [
      "DELETE FROM user_weekly_schedule WHERE user_id = 'e2e00073-0000-0000-0000-000000000063'",
      "DELETE FROM users_plans WHERE user_id = 'e2e00073-0000-0000-0000-000000000063'",

      "DELETE FROM users WHERE user_id = 'e2e00073-0000-0000-0000-000000000063'",

      "INSERT INTO users_plans (plan_id, user_id, template_id, start_date, goal, level, status, mesocycle_number, week_schedule) VALUES ('e2e00073-0a01-0000-0000-000000000063', 'e2e00073-0000-0000-0000-000000000063', 'tpl_fb_3_hyp_int', NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days', 'Ganar masa muscular', 'Intermedio', 'active', 1, 'fb_3')",
      "INSERT INTO user_weekly_schedule (day_routine_id, user_id, week, week_day, session_name, planned_day, planned_day_utc, \"Completed\") VALUES ('e2e00073-5c01-0000-0000-000000000063', 'e2e00073-0000-0000-0000-000000000063', 1, 'Lunes', 'Full Body A', '" + yesterday + "', '" + yesterdayUtc + "', false)",
      "INSERT INTO user_weekly_schedule (day_routine_id, user_id, week, week_day, session_name, planned_day, planned_day_utc, \"Completed\") VALUES ('e2e00073-5c02-0000-0000-000000000063', 'e2e00073-0000-0000-0000-000000000063', 1, 'Miercoles', 'Full Body B', '" + yesterday + "', '" + yesterdayUtc + "', false)",
      "INSERT INTO user_weekly_schedule (day_routine_id, user_id, week, week_day, session_name, planned_day, planned_day_utc, \"Completed\") VALUES ('e2e00073-5c03-0000-0000-000000000063', 'e2e00073-0000-0000-0000-000000000063', 1, 'Viernes', 'Full Body C', '" + yesterday + "', '" + yesterdayUtc + "', false)"
    ],
    validations: [
      {
        id: "V-WSP-301",
        description: "User appears in detection query",
        sql: "WITH current_week_stats AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.full_phone_number, u.full_name, uws.week::int AS current_week, ws.days_per_week::int AS total_sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE uws.\"Completed\" = true)::int AS completed_count, MAX(uws.planned_day) AS last_planned_day FROM users u JOIN users_plans up ON u.user_id = up.user_id AND up.status = 'active' JOIN week_schedules ws ON up.week_schedule = ws.schedule_type JOIN user_weekly_schedule uws ON u.user_id = uws.user_id WHERE uws.week BETWEEN 1 AND 3 GROUP BY u.user_id, u.full_phone_number, u.full_name, uws.week, ws.days_per_week) SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM current_week_stats cws WHERE cws.user_id = 'e2e00073-0000-0000-0000-000000000063' AND cws.last_planned_day < TO_CHAR(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND cws.last_planned_day >= TO_CHAR((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota') - INTERVAL '3 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_weekly_schedule uws2 WHERE uws2.user_id = cws.user_id AND uws2.week = cws.current_week + 1)",
        expected: 1,
        operator: "="
      },
      {
        id: "V-WSP-302",
        description: "completed_count = 0 (RE_ENGAGEMENT scenario)",
        sql: "WITH current_week_stats AS (SELECT u.user_id, uws.week::int AS current_week, ws.days_per_week::int AS total_sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE uws.\"Completed\" = true)::int AS completed_count, MAX(uws.planned_day) AS last_planned_day FROM users u JOIN users_plans up ON u.user_id = up.user_id AND up.status = 'active' JOIN week_schedules ws ON up.week_schedule = ws.schedule_type JOIN user_weekly_schedule uws ON u.user_id = uws.user_id WHERE uws.week BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND u.user_id = 'e2e00073-0000-0000-0000-000000000063' GROUP BY u.user_id, uws.week, ws.days_per_week) SELECT CASE WHEN completed_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as cnt FROM current_week_stats",
        expected: 1,
        operator: "="
      }

const sortedTests = testCases.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
$execution.customData.set('startTime', new Date().toISOString());
$execution.customData.set('totalTests', String(sortedTests.length));
$execution.customData.set('testResults', '[]');
console.log(`\u{1F4CB} WSP Tests cargados: ${sortedTests.map(t => t.id).join(' -> ')}`);
return sortedTests.map(tc => ({ json: tc }));

## WeeklySchedulingPrompt E2E Test Runner

### Validates:
- **TC_WSP_001**: Celebration scenario (3/3 completed)
- **TC_WSP_002**: Growth scenario (1/3 completed)
- **TC_WSP_003**: Re-engagement scenario (0/3 completed)

### What it tests:
1. Detection SQL query identifies qualifying users
2. Completion counts match expected scenario routing
3. 3-day window and week exclusion logic

### Test Users (5700000007X):
| Phone | Scenario | Completed |
|-------|----------|-----------|
| 570000000071 | CELEBRATION | 3/3 |
| 570000000072 | GROWTH | 1/3 |
| 570000000073 | RE_ENGAGEMENT | 0/3 |

### Prerequisites:
- Postgres credential configured
- `week_schedules` table has `fb_3` entry
